invitaciones.soloCreador: For now only the creator is taking part
invitaciones.compartiran: · you'll share the path and each person will check off their own days.
invitaciones.subtitulo: Shared goals you've been invited to.
invitaciones.teUniste: You joined «{{meta}}»! It's now in your goals.
invitaciones.vacioTexto: When someone invites you to a goal, it will show up here and you'll get an email.
invitaciones.vacioCodigo: Did someone share a code with you? Use it in My goals, with «Join with a code».

responder.rechazadaTexto: Done, you declined {{nombre}}'s invitation. If you change your mind, they can invite you again.
responder.siAceptas: If you accept, the goal will appear in your goals: you'll share the path and each person will check off their own days.
responder.conEmail: with {{email}} and come back to this link.
responder.quieresRechazar: Do you want to decline the invitation? {{nombre}} will see that you didn't accept it. You don't need to sign in.

invitar.correoEnviado: We emailed the invitation to {{nombre}}. Once they accept, they'll appear in your goal.
invitar.correoNoEnviado: You invited {{nombre}}. We couldn't send them the email, but they'll see the invitation when they open Metamorfosis.
invitar.explicacion: Whoever accepts will walk the goal with you: you'll share the path and each person will check off their own days. When you mark it as achieved, it will be achieved for everyone.

codigo.errorCopiar: Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it manually.
codigo.texto: Share it in a message: anyone who enters it in «Join with a code» goes straight into the goal.
